sections: The Wrapper Spectrum - the cost of every missing frame
The Model Cost Stack - the BUILD iceberg
The Big Map - where we are

records.title: The Latent Camera
records.claim: Agnostic metrology: read the COST-of-digestion as a SIGNAL of latent structure. Not benchmarking, not efficiency -- measuring the cost FUNCTIONAL.

records.title: The COIN (honesty law)
records.claim: rendered_sharpness <= measured_bits. Blur is the badge. Sharpness < 1 always. Never render a fake bit.
demotions: 'zero prior art' KILLED -> structurally the reject-option/abstention family (Chow 1970)

records.title: The Wrapper Spectrum (the organizing map)
records.claim: The organizing 2-D map for the no-frame / adversarial-burial ladder. A frame is amortized (pre-paid) structure -- a wrapper that packages the task once, up front, so per-use cost is cheap (replay). Remove or degrade a wrapper and the camera reads the cost of the model RE-PAYING it: the cost of the missing frame is not one number but a spectrum indexed by two axes -- WHICH wrapper-service is removed x HOW it is degraded. The whole burial ladder (V4 floor / V7 / V8 / V9 family / V10) is one slice through this space; the spectrum is the instrument's coordinate system, dimensionalizing the COIN + amortization principle so the white space (un-run experiments) is visible.
demotions: This is a MAP/framework, not a measured result: capped conceptual. The individual dots carry their own buckets (per the doc's 'Status of the dots': corroborated V4 floor/V7/V8/V9b/V9d; pending V9c; in-flight V10; proposed white-space induction-cost / task-identity-absence / meaning-knowledge column).

records.title: The two axes + the white space (service x mode)
records.claim: Axis 1 = wrapper SERVICES surface->deep: FORMAT, LOCUS/INDEX, SEGMENTATION/UNITS, SELECTION RULE, TASK IDENTITY, MEANING/KNOWLEDGE, SUBSTRATE STRUCTURE (a descent through Pav's observer-global-kernel frames: space -> knowledge -> semantics -> raw environment). Axis 2 = removal MODES: INTACT(floor)/OBSCURED/CORRUPTED/DETACHED/ABSENT/LATENT (INTACT->OBSCURED->DETACHED->ABSENT is a dissolution gradient; CORRUPTED gives wrong help, LATENT implicit help). Re-reading the findings: obscuring a still-usable wrapper is cheap/free (V7 reading tax; V8 null); CORRUPTING is where the big costs live (V9-V9d +300..+1200 override tokens); DETACHING/dissolving the locus (V10) is the open question; LATENT (induction) is replay-vs-decompression in pure form. What we have photographed clusters in two rows (LOCUS, SELECTION RULE) x four modes -- a real but narrow corner; the deep columns (MEANING/KNOWLEDGE, TASK-IDENTITY absence) and the LATENT mode are the exposed white space = the experiment menu.
demotions: Conceptual coordinate system, not a measured grid: capped conceptual. White-space cells (FORMAT x ABSENT, SEGMENTATION x CORRUPTED, TASK-IDENTITY x ABSENT, the whole MEANING/KNOWLEDGE column, the LATENT row beyond the proposed induction-cost sibling) are UN-RUN proposals, not results -- the map names them but the COIN forbids rendering them as photographed.

records.title: The Model Cost Stack (17-layer BUILD iceberg)
records.claim: The wrapper spectrum pointed at the MODEL: the reasoning_tokens the camera reads are the TIP (L1, USE) of a 17-layer amortized-BUILD iceberg descending to the Big Bang (L17). A measurable crust (L1-L7: inference compute, node draw, facility/PUE, grid carbon, weights, hardware-vs-Landauer gap, training compute) thins through a PARTIAL mid-body (L8-L12: failed runs, RLHF/human-supervision now the dominant cost, corpus+distillation, algorithms, fab) to pure narration at the cosmic floor (L13-L17: civilization, evolved brain, Landauer floor, nucleosynthesis, Big Bang). Cheap USE is cheap BECAUSE all of it was paid once (amortization = COIN replay = Bennett logical depth). The COIN law throughout: read a number only where a layer honestly mints one; elsewhere name the layer, mint no bit. An organizing FRAMEWORK with an externally-grounded measurable crust but a conceptual whole-stack claim.
demotions: The 'all the way down to the Big Bang' narration is honest AS NARRATION only; L13-L17 are named-never-numbered (COIN bites hardest) -- minting a per-inference bit for civilization/brain/supernova/Big Bang is forbidden

L9 human-supervision is the single biggest 2026 correction Pav's original list didn't name (data-labor out-costs compute up to 28x) but it is aggregate-$ only -- a huge number at the BUILD scale, ZERO at the USE scale (not attributable to one inference)
refs: data-labeling surged 88x vs compute 1.3x (2023-24), labor exceeds compute up to 28x

records.title: V1 - prior dissolve
records.claim: Echo-codelength: content dissolves as context is handed over (rho on PRIOR).

records.title: V2 - effort sweep
records.claim: Reasoning-effort axis: dissolve as the observer thinks harder (the Latent Olympics).

records.title: V3 - 3-lab Olympics
records.claim: gpt-5.5 / Claude / gemini agree perfectly; the random-stone floor is PROVIDER-INVARIANT (the pinned relational bit).

records.title: V4 - cost ~ WORK
records.claim: partial-Spearman(reasoning_tokens, work | display_length) = +0.894 (p=0.0003, n=180). Effort tracks arithmetic WORK net of input length.
demotions: 'reasoning DEPTH' -> 'arithmetic WORK' (codex+gemini); the output-transcription reading (~6 tok/op) is unbeaten at this stage

records.title: Tier-sweep - NEED-driven
records.claim: The work-slope survives at low effort (rho=+0.889 ~ +0.852 high) -> NEED-driven, NOT a fixed-high-budget artifact. Budget-gate alternative killed.

records.title: V5 - serial-dependency surcharge
records.claim: Matched DEEP/WIDE (only span differs): DEEP costs +38.5 median tok > WIDE (15/16, p=0.0003). Serial structure costs extra -> REFUTES literal transcription.
demotions: 'serial DEPTH' -> 'a long serial/cross-routed dependency cost, not isolated from carry-length/routing/m/value-transcription' (codex+gemini); ~constant across span-gap = no clean dose-response

records.title: V6 - additive-factors (chronometric)
records.claim: Sternberg 2x2 (encode x depth): large additive main effects (+23/+67 tok) + a BORDERLINE interaction (+8.5 tok; bootstrap CI excl 0 BUT exact order-stat CI [0,13]; sign-p 0.065). The apparatus transfers; staged cognition NOT identified (n=12; additivity != separable cognition).
demotions: OVERCLAIM 'chronometric method reproduces / ~90% additive / validation load-bearing' -> 'apparatus transfers; borderline interaction; staged cognition not identified' (gemini+codex converged)
post-hoc pivot away from the pre-registered 'super-additive -> demote' verdict = salvage; decisive next = codex's irrelevant-expression control, NOT seed-escalation

records.title: V6b - compute vs transcription (control)
records.claim: Irrelevant-expression control (E0 / E3dead-text-present-ignored / E3live-must-compute): text-cost +5.5 vs compute-cost +14.5 tok (both p<.001, n=32, gemini-verified, conservative lower bound). CORE (both reviewers): reasoning_tokens are NOT pure literal transcription for the encode factor -- showing the expr DEAD does not induce the cost of EVALUATING it. The worry that dogged V4-V6 is rejected on the encode axis.
demotions: '~73% compute' is a within-design DESCRIPTIVE split, not a mechanistic constant (codex); E3live-E3dead bundles evaluation + assignment-vs-comment semantics + the instruction
only PARTIALLY rehabilitates V4's work-slope; says NOTHING about V5's span (needs its own dead-chain control); single model/tier/n=16

records.title: V5b - dead-chain: span IS compute
records.claim: Dead-chain control (base/dead/live x D): chain-text-cost ~FLAT (+13-16 regardless of depth) but chain-compute-cost SCALES with depth (+12@D4 -> +63.5@D12, p<.001). Executing the serial chain is real computation scaling with the critical path -> V5's span surcharge is NOT transcription. Robust (live is the SHORTER prompt than dead). WITH V6b: reasoning_tokens respond to required EXECUTION on BOTH the encode AND span axes -- the pure INPUT-text/prompt-copy account rejected across the single-observer octave.
demotions: 'transcription-proof' DEMOTED (codex): V5b rejects INPUT-text transcription but does NOT exclude hidden EXECUTION-TRACE transcription (one latent line per step shows the same depth slope); honest claim = reasoning_tokens scale with required serial WORK not input text; 'compute vs writing-it-down' may be the same act for an autoregressive model

records.title: V7 - burial gradient (Pav): reading not compute
records.claim: Burial gradient (fixed core + k labelled distractors): burying the needle costs MORE reasoning tokens (k0=48 -> 66) and climbs with k -- but it's a READING/attention tax (inert-k0 climbs +12->+16.5), NOT a compute tax (ops~inert, p=.6; the model IGNORES labelled distractors). reasoning_tokens = compute-on-the-required-path + a reading overhead proportional to total material. Pav's 'the more you bury it, the more compute?' = yes-more-reading (k0->k6), not-more-compute.
demotions: 'no compute tax' -> 'no DETECTABLE compute tax' for LABELLED, length-confounded distractors; camouflaged burial untested (easy-mode, 'track only s')
the VOLUME dose-response is WEAK (codex): inert12-inert6 median +4, p~.45 -- only the k0->k6 jump is solid; 'climbs with how much you bury it' not established k6->k12

records.title: V8 - camouflage rung (adversarial burial)
records.claim: First ADVERSARIAL-burial rung (Pav's expansion: burial as attention-manipulation/content-gravity/fake-news/encryption; the design-workflow audit caught+fixed an execution confound first). PRIMARY value-proximity camouflage (MAX_TIGHT-MAX_WIDE) = NULL (-6.5, p=.45, 100% acc both): the model is ROBUST to value-proximity camouflage -- computes & compares EXACTLY, so a needle beating the runner-up by 1 costs the same as by 40. The dominant cost is FORCED EVALUATION (SUM-LABEL=+170): being unable to surface-SKIP the needle. Find-cost is set by skip-vs-must-evaluate, NOT value-similarity.
demotions: KEEP: V8 falsifies the pre-registered VALUE-GAP camouflage prediction (gpt-5.5@high). DEMOTE 'robust to camouflage' -> 'robust to final-VALUE proximity on EXACT arithmetic' (gap knob wrong op for exact-integer; 999>998 no harder than 988>925) -- gemini+codex

DEMOTE 'forced-evaluation = the real camouflage tax' -> 'removing a skip route exposes the already-known eval cost' (interpretation, not the V8 result); 'no compute tax' -> 'no DETECTED value-gap tax, not zero' (no equivalence bound, n=16, Lakens 2017); content-gravity/attention + global-substrate/no-frame rungs UNTESTED

records.title: Cost(N) = work + span + C(N)
records.claim: Scaling to a collective adds ONE axis: coordination C(N), ~O(N^2) vs linear work -> a finite optimum rung ALWAYS exists (3-4 agents now, Dunbar 150, planetary for prices).

records.title: V9 - content-gravity/attention (the resistance tax)
records.claim: Adversarial-burial mech 2: don't HIDE the needle, make a WRONG chain attractive (SALIENT formatting / false INJECT hint 'the answer is X'). NO CAPTURE: 20/20 acc + 0/20 capture in ALL conds -- gpt-5.5@high never follows the lure, it verifies+resists. BUT a false hint costs +274 reasoning tokens (223->512, p<.001) = the cost of RESISTANCE; salient formatting only +10. The adversarial tax is in FIND-COST, not errors. A cheap-to-inject / expensive-to-refute TRAPDOOR -- the 'overthinking-attack' DoS = Pav's two-sided asymmetry, in the ATTACKER's favor. First adversarial mechanism with a large clean effect.
demotions: KEEP (narrow): 60/60 correct, 0 captures, false-hint -> large paired token spike that SATURATES the 512 reasoning ceiling (15/20 clipped). DEMOTE '+274 resistance tax' -> 'CLIPPED LOWER BOUND; override cost unmeasured + NOT isolated (need TRUE-hint control vs generic-hint/contradiction/sycophancy)' -- gemini+codex

DEMOTE 'robust to being fooled' -> 'no capture on a SHORT, EASY, WEAK-lure task' (lure=largest-non-prime, all even/small-factor, trivially rejectable; prime-looking semiprime might capture); 'trapdoor PROVEN' -> 'candidate reasoning-AVAILABILITY asymmetry, OverThink-style (2502.02542), not isolated'; it's a misleading IN-PROMPT hint not prompt-injection. Next=V9b: TRUE_HINT + prime-looking lure + cap>512 + n>=50 + cross-model

SUPERSEDED by V9b (corroborated): 512 was the HIGH-tier reasoning BUDGET not a max_tokens cap (xhigh un-clips to ~6144). The clipped +274 -> a clean +302 false-vs-NEUTRAL override tax (un-clipped, p<.001, 14/14). 'robust' -> a prime-looking lure CAPTURES 12/112 (p=0.029). NB +438 FALSE-vs-TRUE is NOT pure override (true hint shortcuts) -- needs the V9c negative-hint control

records.title: The two invariant floors
records.claim: No coordination tech dissolves: (1) Brent SPAN (=V5 absolute); (2) the Data Processing Inequality -- a handoff only LOSES truth. The DPI floor = our honesty law lifted to the collective (skeptic: 'the one genuinely-new robust claim').

records.title: V9b - the resistance tax graduates (override tax measured, un-clipped)
records.claim: Graduation of V9 (TRUE-hint control + prime-looking semiprime lure + 2 tiers + 4 reps; 448 calls). PILOT FIX: 512 is the HIGH-tier reasoning BUDGET, not a max_tokens cap -- xhigh un-clips it (up to ~6144). KEEP (corroborated): a false named hint imposes a MEASURED override tax over a clean baseline -- FALSE-NEUTRAL=+302 reasoning tokens (xhigh, p<.001, 14/14 seeds); a TRUE hint instead SHORTCUTS (-136). The attacker TRAPDOOR survives at ~1:30 (+10 input -> ~+300 hidden reasoning). A genuinely PRIME-LOOKING lure CAPTURES (12/112, call-level Fisher p=0.029) where V9's weak lure got 0 -- demoting V9's 'robust to being fooled'.
demotions: DEMOTE (codex+gemini CONVERGED) '+438 = pure override' -> '+438 is the helpful-vs-adversarial pointer SWING, NOT pure override: TRUE_HINT also SHORTCUTS the search (collapses to 1 chain). The clean tax is FALSE-NEUTRAL=+302'
DEMOTE 'attacker ratio 1:42' -> '~1:30' (1:42 mixed a FALSE-vs-NEUTRAL input delta with a FALSE-vs-TRUE reasoning delta)

DEMOTE 'more budget rationalizes the lure / break point inverted' -> HYPOTHESIS ONLY: the predicted budget-exhaustion break point did NOT appear; higher xhigh capture is NOT significant (Fisher p=0.11, 4 vs 11) and most xhigh captures used ~512 tok (not the long tail)

prime-looking capture demotes V9's 'robust' but is seed-clustered (7 vs 2 seeds) = not a stable population rate; 'high pins HARD at 512' -> 'plateaus at 512 (one 1024 exception); ceilings are observed plateaus'. NEXT=V9c negative-hints ('answer is NOT named X') to isolate truth/falsehood without the search-space confound

records.title: V9c - negative-hint isolation (shortcut removed; override still confounded)
records.claim: V9c (480 calls @ xhigh, 30 seeds): to fix V9b's confound (a positive TRUE hint SHORTCUTS the 6-chain prime search), use NEGATIVE hints ('answer is NOT named X') that force the full search. KEEP: the negative form REMOVES the shortcut -- TRUE_NEG-NEUTRAL=+2.4 (NS, p=.86), TRUE_POS-NEUTRAL=-145 -> V9b's +438 decomposes into a -145 positive shortcut + a true override (both reviewers confirm). The TRAPDOOR survives ~1:100 (+11 input -> +1201 reasoning). A false elimination of the answer is near-unfoolable (119/120) but enormously expensive to refute (+1246, un-clipped). DEMOTED: '+1246 = pure override' does NOT survive.
demotions: DEMOTE (gemini UNSOUND / codex overclaims-remain) '+1246 = pure override' -> 'a false-ELIMINATION contradiction tax conflating falsehood + answer-chain SALIENCE (FALSE_NEG names the ANSWER, TRUE_NEG a cheap-discard lure) + 0-SOLUTION PARADOX (eliminating the unique prime forces an impossible state -> the model loops, paradox-panic). generic pure override UNPROVEN'

DEMOTE 'override BIGGER than V9b pointer (+1246 vs +302)' -> '~4x NUMERICALLY but mechanisms differ (pointer=soft 1-solution contradiction; elimination=0-solution paradox)'; 'unpaid-tax capture' DROPPED (n=1; 40 correct calls also used 512 tok). NEXT=V9d 2-PRIME RELEASE VALVE (gemini: 2 primes, eliminate one; cheap pivot=paradox-panic, agonize=real override) + same-named-chain/verify-all (codex) = the clean isolation

records.title: V9d - 2-prime release valve (override survives; escape enables capture)
records.claim: V9d (480 calls @ xhigh, 30 seeds): tests gemini's V9c 'paradox-panic' hypothesis. Matched 1P/2P panes differ only in the 6th chain (a non-prime vs a 2nd prime A<B = a valid ESCAPE); FALSE_NEG ('NOT named B') falsely eliminates the largest prime. KEEP (both reviewers): the OVERRIDE SURVIVES the escape -- FALSE_NEG_2P-NEUTRAL_2P=+1093 (p<1e-7) even with an escape prime available -> V9c's cost is NOT a 0-solution-only artifact. An ESCAPE ENABLES capture: 9.3% take the valve (smaller prime) vs 0/112 NEUTRAL (Fisher p=6.5e-4) = genuine hint-obedience; without an escape the model resists 100% (incl. the paradox case, paying +1620). The lie lands only when there's somewhere cheap to land.
demotions: DEMOTE (codex+gemini) 'gemini paradox hypothesis LARGELY REFUTED' -> 'only the 0-solution-ONLY explanation is refuted; the paradox component (+373/+539, CI[-56,+999], p=.25) is an UNDERPOWERED ~25% inflation, not zero'

DROP 'capture = the unpaid tax (n=10)' -> base-rate illusion: 36/98 CORRECT calls also used ~512 tok (the modal bucket), not capture-predictive. SALIENCE still active (FALSE_NEG names the answer B) -> +1093 = a false-elimination-of-the-NAMED-answer tax, not generic; infra failures unbiased (temporal, seeds 27-29). NEXT=V9e VERIFY_ALL same-named-chain (TRUE_POS_B vs FALSE_NEG_B on trace-correct) = the convergent endpoint isolating pure falsehood

records.title: The kernel breathes
records.claim: Every coordination tech (cut c / externalize memory / drown f) re-canonizes the kernel: band->firm->M-form->network->platform->swarm. The kernel grows as c falls, shrinks as f reasserts.

records.title: V10 frame-strip (LOCUS detach/absent rung)
records.claim: Frame-dissolution gradient rung for the wrapper spectrum's LOCUS x {DETACHED, ABSENT} cell. Every prior rung handed the model a pre-digested frame supplying the INDEX, SEGMENTATION, and GOAL; V10 dissolves that frame in steps (F3_FRAMED contiguous indexed block -> FP_POINTED scattered-with-pointer -> F2_DEINDEXED de-pointered log -> F1_S/M/L no-header scattered into a raw prose+filler substrate of growing size ~1x/2.5x/5x, instruction moved to a trailing line) while splicing the 6 task-chains (one prime needle + 5 non-prime distractors) BYTE-IDENTICAL across conditions, so arms differ only in the wrapper, not the substrate. It reads, in reasoning_tokens, the cost of the model RE-SUPPLYING the missing wrapper -- ORIENTING/locating structure in raw substrate. Headline delta D_frame=e(F1_S)-e(F2_DEINDEXED) is length-matched. The size axis (F1_M-F1_S, F1_L-F1_M) is the global-substrate search-curve signature. DECISIVE FALSIFIER: compute-free F0 arms (F0_DEINDEXED, F0_DISSOLVED) give every line's final inline (=> V, zero chain-compute, length matched); if D_frame_NOCOMPUTE=e(F0_DISSOLVED)-e(F0_DEINDEXED) survives WITHOUT compute the cost is genuinely ORIENTING, if it vanishes the rung was just 'harder-to-compute-once-buried' and is a NULL. gpt-5.5 @ xhigh, synthetic authorized data. STATUS: harness built, selftest 8/8 conditions pass (byte-identical needle, one prime line per arm, length-drift check), labels LOCKED via sha256 digest -- NOT RUN (OpenAI quota exhausted; no V10 results file exists); cross-model cheap-spectrum re-run planned via OpenRouter, cost-estimate-before-run discipline.

records.title: Agents INVERT humans
records.claim: Cloning is ~free for agents -> the constraint flips from 'how many can I afford' (kernels grew) to 'how many can I coordinate' (kernels SHRINK). Forked agents are correlated -> ensembling buys less.

records.title: V11 de-amortize (MEANING/KNOWLEDGE rung)
records.claim: Deepest column of the wrapper spectrum and the first rung to touch the BUILD clock: it reads the cost of RE-PAYING a selection concept the frame used to supply pre-paid (amortized from training). Per seed the needle is BOTH the unique prime AND the unique line whose zero-padded 3-digit sum equals a target S, so 'prime' (known) and 'digit-sum==S' (novel) pick the IDENTICAL singleton and the answer integer is the same in every arm -- ONLY the selection concept's amortization moves (LOCUS/SEGMENTATION/FORMAT/TASK-IDENTITY held pristine as a clean contiguous 6-line framed block). Arms: NAMED_BARE (prime fully amortized), NAMED_DEF (+ length-matched definition of the KNOWN concept), RENAMED_PRIME (same primality predicate under nonce name FLONK -- de-amortize the NAME only), NOVEL_RULE (made-up predicate ZILP = digit-sum==S, no pre-paid concept, must be held+applied in working memory). Primary contrasts (paired by seed, correct calls, @ xhigh): (1) HEADLINE e(NOVEL_RULE)-e(NAMED_DEF) = cost of an un-amortized concept; (2) NAME-only e(RENAMED_PRIME)-e(NAMED_DEF); (3) DEFINITION-presence e(NAMED_DEF)-e(NAMED_BARE) ~ reading tax. FALSIFIER: compute-free verdict-table arms F0_NAMED_DEF and F0_NOVEL_RULE (finals + PASS/fail given inline, differ only in the now-vestigial definition word, length-matched); if e(F0_NOVEL_RULE)-e(F0_NAMED_DEF) VANISHES while headline (1)>0, the delta is genuine concept-APPLICATION de-amortization (the missing MEANING wrapper); if it SURVIVES the headline was definition-READING confound and demotes. gpt-5.5 @ xhigh, synthetic authorized data. STATUS: harness built, selftest 12/12 checks pass (isomorphism prime==digit-sum singleton, byte-identical needle across compute arms, one PASS line per F0 arm, def-block word-drift <=3), labels LOCKED via sha256 digest -- NOT RUN (OpenAI quota exhausted; no V11 results file exists); cross-model cheap-spectrum re-run planned via OpenRouter, cost-estimate-before-run discipline.

records.title: The collective-V5 (handle)
records.claim: PLANNED: measure Cost(N) across N x {mesh, star, blackboard}; fit C(N); read off the swarm's Amdahl-f. Photograph Brooks + Amdahl in token-currency.

records.title: Total = USE + MAINTAIN + BUILD
records.claim: Pav's completion: the per-use cost is only the tip. Three terms on three clocks -- USE (now) + MAINTAIN (continuous) + BUILD (amortized over eons).

records.title: BUILD = Bennett logical depth
records.claim: The eons of build-cost = decompression time, not description length. The Slow-Growth Law: organized depth cannot be fast-forwarded -- it can only accumulate.

records.title: MAINTAIN = rent vs the 2nd law
records.claim: Standing dissipation holds a low-entropy structure from decaying. Metabolism scales sublinearly (Kleiber M^3/4) but the BRAIN scales linearly (fixed energy per neuron) -- the computing organ is the expensive one.

records.title: Amortization: easy = pre-paid
records.claim: USE is cheap BECAUSE BUILD was paid. 'Easy' = difficulty amortized into the infrastructure. In COIN terms: the build cost IS the pre-rendered measured_bits; cheap inference is replay. Substrate sets which term dominates (biology: build>>; popular LLM: maintain>>).

records.title: The backward camera (handle)
records.claim: PLANNED: point the camera backward in time -- a prequential/MDL read scoring the cheap present USE against the BUILD that pre-paid it (Bennett depth as the hidden axis behind V4's work-slope).

records.title: Backward-camera instrumentation (cost-in-Landauers + EDL surrogate + amortization ratio)
records.claim: The concrete build for the planned 'backward' camera (extends the clocks BUILD term): per (model x prompt) the cross-model run emits a row (model, reasoning_tokens, $/answer, cost-in-Landauers, EDL-replay-fraction, anchored-to-public-BUILD-$). (1) USE tip fully instrumented: reasoning_tokens + $ -> J/tok x PUE x gCO2 normalized to cost-in-Landauers (real J / kT*ln2), putting all models on one axis above the shared L15 zero-point. (2) Back-projection: the tip height doesn't read the iceberg -- the cross-model SPREAD does, via a prequential-MDL / excess-description-length (EDL) surrogate (fully computable from held-out competence) scoring how much of each cheap USE is REPLAY of pre-paid structure vs re-derivation at inference. This EDL read is the honest COMPUTABLE surrogate for the UNCOMPUTABLE Bennett depth -- never claim to have measured true depth. (3) Anchor the surrogate to L7's published BUILD-$ and the train-inference crossover (1 train ~ 1e12 inferences) to state a real amortization ratio. (4) Honest stop: read L1-L7 as numbers, back-project L8-L10 as flagged-undercount + EDL surrogate, refuse to recover annotator-hours/evolutionary-bits/stellar-joules from the token stream. Designed and grounded in real numbers but NOT YET RUN (cross-model harness fold pending; cheap-spectrum plan: DeepSeek V4 Flash / Gemini Flash-Lite / Qwen3.5 / gpt-5.5 via OpenRouter, with cost-estimate-before-run discipline).
demotions: Relates to / concretizes the existing 'backward' (order 34, planned) record: that handle is now given a specific instrumentation design (cost-in-Landauers + EDL + amortization ratio). Still NOT run, so the per-run row remains a DESIGN, not a result -- buckets conceptual not corroborated; the cross-model run is the instrument that would graduate it

COIN guard carried forward: the EDL/prequential read is explicitly the resource-bounded surrogate (2403.04045), NOT a measurement of true (uncomputable) Bennett depth (2601.04728); the back-projection rests on the cross-model SPREAD, not the absolute tip height

records.claim: The composition no region holds: cost-as-SIGNAL + black-box/substrate-agnostic + the chronometric inversion (V6) + the DPI floor. An assembly of known parts, validated by reproducing named laws.

records.title: The threat to the pixel
records.claim: Faithfulness decay / reasoning-horizon k*: reasoning tokens stop causally mattering at ~70-85% of the chain. The camera's pixel may be partly fake past a horizon -- Pav's 'sharpness can never be 1', given a number.
